name: 霓虹电玩
details: Keep the orange-haired tiger girl with the charcoal gaming jacket and headset, midnight-navy opaque panel, turquoise and pink thin angular corner accents. Dark navy text area absolutely flat, no gradients or glare. Small generic game symbols only on fixed corner ends.
prompt:
Use case: background-extraction / precise-object-edit. From the approved reference board extract ONLY the TOP HORIZONTAL candidate-window skin with its mascot. Keep the same character, costume, colors, material and shape language. Keep the orange-haired tiger girl with the charcoal gaming jacket and headset, midnight-navy opaque panel, turquoise and pink thin angular corner accents. Dark navy text area absolutely flat, no gradients or glare. Small generic game symbols only on fixed corner ends.
Delete all words, numbers, ab text, cursors, selected-candidate highlight, separators and background scenery. The text-bar interior must be entirely blank, a uniform opaque #172238 fill with no designs. Output only the isolated complete illustration: the long bar and the character leaning over its top-right edge. Tight landscape cutout, roughly 3:1 overall aspect ratio, small safety padding, character ears and decorations fully in frame.
The middle of the bar should consist only of straight top/bottom rims with a plain fill; keep mascot and ornaments confined to the ends so the center can stretch. Keep side edges straight through the empty text row. Genuine alpha=0 TRANSPARENCY immediately outside the hard illustrated silhouette. NO halo, NO bloom, NO cast shadow, NO blurry glow, NO mist, NO background color wash. No board, no swatches, no white/black background, no second asset, no text anywhere.
